name: form-workout-planner
description: A mobile-first weekly gym planner with Firebase workout tracking.

scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-form --only auth,firestore "npm run test:cloud"
scripts.test:cloud: node --test tests/firebase/*.test.mjs && npm run build:test:cloud && playwright test --config playwright.firebase.config.js && npm run test:setup
scripts.format: prettier --write src shared tests vite.config.js playwright*.js package.json firebase.json README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
